name: Tensor Ventures
decision_note: Prague deep-tech seed/Series A VC (Luxembourg Fund I, EIF/NPO-backed co-investment fund in preparation); led Pointee's seed (April 2026) and Repsense's round (Dec 2025) and joined Valka.ai's pre-seed (Feb 2026).

evidence.quote: Tensor Ventures explores deep tech innovation's frontiers & invests in uncharted territories.
We embrace inevitable tectonic shifts; the rise of AI, Quantum Revolution, Computational Biotech or Sustainable Tech.
We participate in Seed and Series A rounds.

As a financial market participant, Tensor Ventures GP S.à r.l (the “GP”), as general partner and registered AIFM of Tensor Ventures Fund I (the “Fund”) makes the following disclosure in accordance with SFDR regulation.
Nejprve začali se svými penězi, pak v roce 2017 otevřeli první fond, do něhož získali dvacet milionů eur, a tento kapitál již rozinvestovali do dvacítky startupů.
Vznikne tak projekt koinvestičního fondu zvaný Tensor Ventures Co-investment Fund, který cílí na celkovou velikost až 50 milionů eur (zhruba 1,25 miliardy korun)
Investici vedl český fond Tensor Ventures, ke kterému se přidal Seed Starter České i Slovenské spořitelny.
Startup v pre-seedovém kole získal rekordní investici 12 milionů eur, tedy necelých 300 milionů korun, a to od tuzemských fondů J&T Ventures, Tensor Ventures
Investiční kolo vedl český deeptech fond Tensor Ventures, přidaly se Seed Starter České spořitelny a stávající litevští investoři BSV Ventures a Coinvest Capital.
Konkrétně jde o české fondy Tensor Ventures, Lighthouse Ventures, Moondust Ventures, 22 Hor Invest a také zahraniční BSV Ventures.

analyst_notes: Structure: Fund I is Tensor Ventures Fund I SCSp with Tensor Ventures GP S.à r.l. as general partner and registered AIFM (Luxembourg, per the site's SFDR legal disclosure e4); GLEIF lists 'Tensor Ventures Fund I' with LEI 984500BF974QT5DAK471 (Luxembourg RCS B277418, active); no LEI/RCS found for the GP, so its registry_id is null; the team and Czech contact are in Prague (Karlín), and Tensor Ventures a.s. (IČO 06257241, Pernerova 635/57, Praha 8) is the Czech company of the founders - role not confirmed, marked 'other'. Other Tensor-named Czech companies at the same address (Tensor I. s.r.o. 17628504, Tensor Advisory s.r.o. 19987544, Tensor Warehouse s.r.o. 22245031) were not linked to the funds by any source and are not listed. Capital: Fund I EUR 20m opened in 2017 (CzechCrunch 2024-05-15) - the latest closed fund found; the Tensor Ventures Co-investment Fund (EIF / Czech National Recovery Plan RRF fund-of-funds, up to EUR 20m from EIF) targets up to EUR 50m - no close announcement found, so it is recorded as a target only. Ticket: the website states none; EUR 250k-1m is the CVCA self-reported profile (2020) - labelled self_reported. Geography 'EU, US' is likewise only self-reported (CVCA); observed deals are CZ, LT, NL. Stage: site says Seed and Series A; observed rounds also include pre-seed (QurieGen, Valka.ai, Edmund AI Feb 2025). Investment amounts are total round sizes: Pointee USD 1.4m seed led by Tensor; Valka.ai EUR 12m pre-seed led by Rockaway Ventures; Repsense (Lithuanian, platform 'Havel') EUR 1.1m led by Tensor; QurieGen EUR 2.2m pre-seed led by Tensor (amount and lead in adjacent sentences of the same article).
